title: Finite exterior Koszul and ordered tensor-dual towers agree
statement: Let X, A, d, r, a, C and the explicitly constructed small completed ringed site be as in [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let G be the actual module equivalence, H the composite of backward coefficient restriction with G, applied termwise, P the coefficient-presentation complex of C, N=G(C), and b the transported scalar list. For each natural m the complex H(completedKoszulTensor(P,m)) is isomorphic to the m-th level of the strict ordered tensor-dual tower of N [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. These isomorphisms commute with every consecutive power transition and carry the transported finite exterior augmentation, including the identity-on-sections round trip, to the specified tensor-dual augmentation in every degree. The finite list may be empty; no regularity or generation assumption is imposed. This statement contains no countable product, mapping cone, localization or inverse-limit comparison.

source.place: more-algebra.tex Tag 0664, Lemma 15.29.12, tensor decomposition of the exterior Koszul complex; algebraization.tex Tag 0A0E, proof of lemma-derived-completion-koszul: dual of the finite ordered positive tensor complex.

proof.text: Use completedKoszulCoefficientComparison for the finite coefficient tower and completedCechTensorTransport for total tensor transport. Compose their isomorphisms using the tensor functor on the fixed first factor. Naturality of the tensor comparison and functoriality carry the coefficient transition equation to the full tower equation. The explicit componentwise identity identifies the tensor tower with the complex transposed back from CochainComplex.of; its differential equation is CochainComplex.of_d.

For the augmentation, evaluate tensor transport on the degree-zero exterior unit. The coefficient augmentation equation identifies its image with the degree-zero dual unit. The total tensor map on the (q,0) summand and the explicit inverse right unitor give the exact displayed augmentation equation.

lean.statement: theorem completedKoszulFiniteComparison (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) ℤ) : let G := (completedCechModulesEquiv X d).functor let H := (intrinsicPresentationModulesBack X d ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) let P := (intrinsicPresentationComplex X d).obj C let O := completedCechRing X d let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i) let N := (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C let T := ringedKoszulTensorTowerComplex O r b N ∃ e : ∀ m : ℕ, H.obj (completedKoszulTensor X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d) r a P m) ≅ T.asFunctor.obj (op m), (∀ m, H.map (completedKoszulTensorTransition X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d) r a P m) ≫ (e m).hom = (e (m + 1)).hom ≫ T.asFunctor.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (q : ℤ), G.map ((intrinsicPresentationRoundTrip X d).hom.app (C.X q) ≫ (intrinsicPresentationModulesBack X d).map ((completedKoszulTensorUnit X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d) r a P m).f q)) ≫ (e m).hom.f q = (ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent O r b N (op m)).f q)
